package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

func (client Client) GetTeacherOnboardingState(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState, error) {
	studentID = strings.TrimSpace(studentID)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpointWithToken("/internal/v1/teacher/students/"+url.PathEscape(studentID)+"/onboarding/draft", client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, mapOnboardingStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var state domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &state); err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	state, err = domain.NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(state, studentID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	return state, nil
}

// Deprecated: retained only for compatibility evidence. New Teacher
// onboarding actions use ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn through the coordinator.
func (client Client) ReplaceTeacherOnboardingDraft(ctx context.Context, studentID, idempotencyKey string, expectedVersion int64, answers domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	studentID, idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil || expectedVersion < 0 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Schema          string `json:"schema"`
		ExpectedVersion int64  `json:"expected_version"`
		domain.StudentOnboardingAnswers
	}{domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, expectedVersion, answers})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > 16<<10 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpointWithToken("/internal/v1/teacher/students/"+url.PathEscape(studentID)+"/onboarding/draft", client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPut, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, mapOnboardingStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var draft domain.StudentOnboardingDraft
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &draft); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	state, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{Schema: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, Draft: draft, ProfileVersion: 0}, studentID)
	if err != nil || state.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftDraft || state.Draft.Version != expectedVersion+1 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
	}
	return state.Draft, nil
}

// Deprecated: retained only for compatibility evidence. New Teacher
// onboarding actions use ApplyTeacherOnboardingTurn through the coordinator.
func (client Client) FinalizeTeacherOnboardingDraft(ctx context.Context, studentID, idempotencyKey string, expectedDraftVersion, expectedProfileVersion int64) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse, error) {
	studentID, idempotencyKey = strings.TrimSpace(studentID), strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey)
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(studentID); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil || expectedDraftVersion < 1 || expectedProfileVersion < 0 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Schema                 string `json:"schema"`
		ExpectedDraftVersion   int64  `json:"expected_draft_version"`
		ExpectedProfileVersion int64  `json:"expected_profile_version"`
	}{domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeSchema, expectedDraftVersion, expectedProfileVersion})
	if err != nil || len(payload) > 1<<10 {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	endpoint, err := client.endpointWithToken("/internal/v1/teacher/students/"+url.PathEscape(studentID)+"/onboarding/draft/finalize", client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, err
	}
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	client.authorizeWithToken(request, client.LearningWorkspaceToken)
	response, err := client.do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = response.Body.Close() }()
	if response.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, mapOnboardingStatus(response.StatusCode, response.Status)
	}
	var result domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse
	if err := decodeStrict(response.Body, &result); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, unavailable(err)
	}
	state, err := domain.NormalizeTeacherStudentOnboardingState(domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingState{Schema: domain.TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, Draft: result.Draft, ProfileVersion: result.Profile.Version}, studentID)
	if err != nil || result.Schema != domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult || state.Draft.Status != domain.StudentOnboardingDraftCompleted || result.Profile.StudentID != studentID || result.Profile.Version < 1 || result.Profile.ProfileVersion != "student-onboarding-v1" || result.Profile.CreatedAt.IsZero() || result.Profile.UpdatedAt.Before(result.Profile.CreatedAt) || state.Draft.CompletedProfileVersion == nil || *state.Draft.CompletedProfileVersion != result.Profile.Version {
		return domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResponse{}, unavailable(domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
	}
	result.Draft = state.Draft
	return result, nil
}

func mapOnboardingStatus(statusCode int, status string) error {
	switch statusCode {
	case http.StatusBadRequest:
		return domain.ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	case http.StatusConflict:
		return domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	case http.StatusNotFound:
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: onboarding draft not found", domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict)
	default:
		return unavailableStatus(status)
	}
}

var _ repository.StudentOnboardingGateway = Client{}
